dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters's latest account says Trump describes U.S.-Iran talks as good but still threatens renewed strikes if diplomacy fails. Saudi Arabia attributes drones aimed at petroleum sites to Iran-backed Iraqi groups; satellite reporting and imagery-based coverage show fire or damage at Abqaiq, while the direct strike pause continues. The confirmed energy-site threat activates oil_infrastructure_threat, but the raw score was already capped. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN News reports more than 4,300 killed and 12,200 injured in Lebanon since 2 March and says Israeli air attacks and Hezbollah fighting have continued after the 17 April conditional ceasefire. The UN rights chief warned the resulting displacement and denial of return could amount to international crimes; no withdrawal timetable or new strategic Hezbollah threshold was announced. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day Google/Bing and allied-position review found Greek air-defence analysis and Turkish diplomacy, not a verified Turkish combat entry, unusual force concentration, qualifying long-range weapons event or official atomic-weapons threshold. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.notes: A Rawadari retrospective documents casualties from Pakistani attacks since December 2024; a Taliban claim of 400 deaths in a Kabul hospital strike is denied by Pakistan and remains uncorroborated. dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN Security Council coverage confirms rising civilian harm and attacks on Black Sea ports, ships and diplomatic premises while reciprocal strikes continue. The high-intensity war persists, but no new strategic posture change or direct NATO combat entry was verified after the prior scan. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Later indexing repeated Romania's expulsion of a Russian embassy employee after drone incursions. dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Taiwan reporting counted 11 Chinese ships and three military aircraft, consistent with persistent pressure but not a blockade or amphibious concentration. No expanded live-fire operation, hostile collision or direct China-Taiwan clash was verified in the rolling-day review. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: South Korean monitoring reports say no new North Korean personnel have been observed in Russia, while Zelenskyy's 30,000-person allegation continues to circulate. No independently verified movement, launcher relocation, operational firing or prohibited detonation appeared. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Radio Dabanga independently reports that local sources dispute the army's claim that the Omdurman-El Obeid road reopened: fighting continues, the RSF retains Reihad El Nuba and civilian movement is unsafe. It also reports a new RSF drone attack on El Obeid with no immediate casualty or damage figure. The offensive signal remains active, but the mixed control picture does not justify another score increase. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.notes: Rolling-day indexing added election-delay and humanitarian commentary, not a new South Sudan-Abyei clash, verified large force movement, transition breakdown or UNISFA posture change. Raw 19; coupled 19
